title: Fluffy Pancakes
instructions: 1. Whisk the dry ingredients. 2. Whisk milk, egg, vanilla and melted butter. 3. Combine and cook 1/4 cup at a time on a hot griddle.

title: Scrambled Eggs
instructions: 1. Whisk eggs, milk, salt and pepper. 2. Cook in butter over low heat, stirring gently.

title: French Toast
instructions: 1. Whisk eggs, milk, sugar, cinnamon and vanilla. 2. Dip bread slices. 3. Cook in butter until golden.

title: Veggie Omelette
description: Loaded with peppers, spinach and mushrooms.
instructions: 1. Saute pepper, mushrooms and spinach in butter. 2. Add beaten eggs and cook until set. 3. Add cheddar and fold.

title: Banana Oatmeal
description: Warm oats with banana and honey.
instructions: 1. Simmer oats in milk with salt and cinnamon. 2. Stir in sliced banana. 3. Drizzle with honey.

title: Spaghetti Marinara
instructions: 1. Boil spaghetti. 2. Saute onion and garlic in oil; add tomatoes and oregano and simmer 15 min. 3. Toss with pasta and parmesan.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: 1. Cook bacon until crisp. 2. Boil spaghetti. 3. Off the heat, toss pasta with bacon, beaten eggs, parmesan and pepper.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: 1. Cook rice (day-old is best). 2. Brown diced chicken; set aside. 3. Stir-fry onion, garlic and peas; add rice, eggs, chicken, soy sauce and sesame oil.

title: Grilled Cheese
instructions: 1. Butter the bread. 2. Put cheddar between the slices. 3. Cook in a pan until golden on both sides.

title: Roasted Broccoli
instructions: 1. Toss broccoli with oil, garlic and salt. 2. Roast at 425F for 20 min. 3. Top with parmesan.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
description: Chicken and vegetables in a savory sauce.
instructions: 1. Cook rice. 2. Stir-fry chicken; set aside. 3. Stir-fry vegetables, garlic and ginger. 4. Add chicken and a sauce of soy, oyster sauce and cornstarch.

title: Beef Tacos
instructions: 1. Brown beef with spices. 2. Warm tortillas. 3. Fill with beef, cheese, tomato, lettuce, sour cream and salsa.

title: Chicken Quesadillas
instructions: 1. Cook diced chicken with pepper, onion and cumin. 2. Fill tortillas with chicken and cheese. 3. Cook until crisp; serve with salsa and sour cream.

title: Black Bean Soup
instructions: 1. Saute onion, carrot, celery and garlic. 2. Add beans, broth and spices; simmer 25 min. 3. Blend partly and finish with lime.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: 1. Saute onion, carrot and celery in butter. 2. Add broth, chicken and bay leaves; simmer 20 min. 3. Shred chicken and add noodles until tender.

title: Tomato Soup
description: Creamy and pairs with grilled cheese.
instructions: 1. Saute onion and garlic in butter. 2. Add tomatoes, broth and sugar; simmer 20 min. 3. Blend and stir in cream.

title: Classic Beef Chili
instructions: 1. Brown beef with onion, pepper and garlic. 2. Stir in spices and tomato paste. 3. Add beans and tomatoes; simmer 45 min.

title: Mac and Cheese
instructions: 1. Boil macaroni. 2. Make a roux with butter and flour; whisk in milk. 3. Melt in cheddar, mustard and paprika; stir in pasta.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
instructions: 1. Boil spaghetti. 2. Saute shrimp in oil and butter with garlic and pepper flakes. 3. Toss with pasta, lemon and parmesan.

title: Baked Salmon with Lemon
instructions: 1. Mix oil, garlic, dijon and lemon juice. 2. Brush over salmon and season. 3. Bake at 400F for 12-15 min.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: 1. Chop romaine. 2. Toss with dressing and a squeeze of lemon. 3. Top with croutons, parmesan and pepper.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: 1. Chop cucumber, tomato and red onion. 2. Add olives and feta. 3. Dress with oil, vinegar, oregano and salt.

title: Guacamole
instructions: 1. Mash avocados with lime juice and salt. 2. Fold in onion, jalapeno, tomato and cilantro.

title: Mashed Potatoes
instructions: 1. Boil peeled potatoes with garlic until tender. 2. Drain and mash with butter, milk and sour cream. 3. Season.

title: Roasted Sweet Potatoes
instructions: 1. Cube sweet potatoes. 2. Toss with oil and spices. 3. Roast at 425F for 30 min, flipping once.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: 1. Cream butter and sugars; beat in eggs and vanilla. 2. Mix in flour, baking soda and salt, then chips. 3. Bake at 375F for 10-12 min.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: 1. Mash bananas; mix with melted butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla. 2. Stir in dry ingredients and walnuts. 3. Bake at 350F for 60 min.

title: Fudgy Brownies
instructions: 1. Melt butter; whisk in sugar, eggs and vanilla. 2. Stir in cocoa, flour, salt and baking powder, then chips. 3. Bake at 350F for 25 min.

title: Chickpea Curry
instructions: 1. Cook rice. 2. Saute onion, garlic and ginger; add spices. 3. Add chickpeas, tomatoes and coconut milk; simmer 15 min. 4. Stir in spinach.

title: Beef and Broccoli
instructions: 1. Cook rice. 2. Sear sliced steak; set aside. 3. Steam-fry broccoli, garlic and ginger. 4. Add beef and a sauce of soy, oyster sauce, sugar and cornstarch.

title: Chicken Alfredo
instructions: 1. Season and cook chicken; slice. 2. Boil fettuccine. 3. Simmer butter, garlic and cream; melt in parmesan. 4. Toss everything together.

title: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in spiced tomato sauce.
instructions: 1. Saute onion, pepper and garlic with spices. 2. Add tomatoes and simmer 10 min. 3. Crack in eggs, cover and cook until set. 4. Top with feta and cilantro.

title: BLT Sandwich
instructions: 1. Cook bacon until crisp. 2. Toast bread and spread with mayo. 3. Layer bacon, lettuce and tomato.

title: Tuna Salad Sandwich
instructions: 1. Mix tuna, mayo, celery, onion, dijon and lemon. 2. Season. 3. Spread on bread.

title: Hummus
instructions: 1. Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and salt. 2. Stream in oil until smooth. 3. Dust with paprika.

title: Lentil Soup
instructions: 1. Saute onion, carrot, celery and garlic. 2. Add lentils, broth, tomatoes, cumin and bay leaf; simmer 35 min. 3. Stir in spinach.

title: Spaghetti and Meatballs
instructions: 1. Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, garlic and seasoning; roll into balls. 2. Brown meatballs. 3. Simmer in tomato sauce with onion for 20 min. 4. Serve over spaghetti.

title: Honey Garlic Chicken
instructions: 1. Cook rice. 2. Sear chicken thighs until cooked through. 3. Add honey, soy sauce and garlic; reduce until sticky. 4. Top with green onion.

title: Overnight Oats
instructions: 1. Stir oats, almond milk, yogurt, honey and cinnamon in a jar. 2. Refrigerate overnight. 3. Top with banana.

title: Apple Crisp
instructions: 1. Toss sliced apples with sugar, cinnamon and lemon. 2. Rub flour, oats, brown sugar, salt and butter into a crumble. 3. Top apples and bake at 350F for 45 min.
